name: Startup.sx

sources.title: Batch-provided submit URL — returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) to automated fetches on repeated tries
Live product page (via search index) — shows 'Verified' badge, launch date, upvotes, category, maker profile, promoted slots, discussion

Firsto directory profile of Startup.sx — community-curated launch platform; free submission with manual review, account required, $9.99 paid promotion (instant publish, homepage feature, dofollow backlink)
Smol Launch 410+ directory list — lists Startup.sx as a submission destination

conditions: Free submission exists but requires creating an account and passing manual review before the listing appears
Paid $9.99 option skips the queue: instant publish, homepage feature, dofollow backlink (per Firsto's profile)
requirements: Product/startup fit — platform is positioned as a minimalist Product Hunt alternative for indie makers; listings have launch date, category (e.g., 'ai tools'), maker profile
Manual review for the free tier; no mandatory backlink/badge for free listings per third-party profiles
preparation: Product name, tagline, full description, category
Maker profile details (products carry a 'Maker' section)
workflow: Open https://www.startup.sx/submit (site rate-limits bots — use a normal browser session)
Fill in product details and choose the free submission path
Wait for manual review; listing appears on the site with upvote/discussion features once approved
watchFor: Site aggressively rate-limits automated fetches (HTTP 429) — do not hammer it; submit via a real browser
Free listings sit in a review queue while $9.99 buys instant publish — don't pay if the queue is the only difference you need
Third-party profiles disagree slightly on DR (29-32); treat 'dofollow' claims for paid tier as unverified
'Promoted' section shows paid placements mixed into product pages
countsAsLive: A product page exists at startup.sx/product/<slug> with launch date, upvote count, and category — publicly browsable without login
unknowns: Exact form fields (submit page could not be fetched — persistent 429)
Whether free listings get dofollow or nofollow links
How large/active the community voting actually is
